mentions.name: Mujo
mentions.description: Mujo is a minimalist productivity app for musicians that bundles time tracking, task management, notes, and other practice-journal tools into a simple metronome interface. It is available on iOS, with an Android version being considered.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been building a minimalist productivity app for musicians. Mujo adds time tracking, task management, notes and other “practice journal” tools into a simple metronome interface. Been hacking at the iOS version for a while, and starting to think about Android.
